verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; intake pipeline shows zero conversions recorded.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 99 leads at $7.46 cost per lead on $738.15 in Meta spend — a solid 28-day base. However, the most recent 7 days show a real pullback: leads are down 45% and cost per lead is up 83% week-over-week, confirmed by the last three days producing only 6 leads at meaningfully higher cost. The retargeting campaign carrying half the budget is showing signs of audience fatigue, and ad creative is being refreshed this week to address it. Separately, 101 opportunities are sitting in the pipeline with zero recorded wins and zero appointments logged, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being captured and followed up — that intake process is being reviewed as a priority alongside the ad work.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days at $7.46 each
drop in leads over the past 7 days versus the prior 7
pipeline wins recorded across 101 open opportunities this period

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead spiked 83% week-over-week and the top retargeting campaign is showing fatigue; at the same time, 75 phone calls from Google Business Profile are not yet connected to your pipeline, so the real lead picture is likely under-reported.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed now to reset audience fatigue, and phone-call attribution is being linked to the pipeline so those calls are counted and followed up correctly.
